title: Finally Apple Watch Series 4 Announced!!!
text:
September 13, 2018 Finally Apple Watch Series 4 Announced!!!
Finally Apple Watch Series 4 Announced in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) ‘s event the first device unveiled today was the Apple Watch Series 4, it would feature a larger display, Apple had a handful of other tricks up its sleeve.
The Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) ‘s Watch Series 4 features a 30% larger display, and along with this it is showcasing a handful of new watch faces, that show more information and stretch all the way to the edges of the display.
Apple also says the body of the Apple Watch is slightly thinner, with (almost) the same 18-hour, all-day battery life. The Digital Crown has been updated to add support for haptic feedback, which means as you scroll through lists, you’ll feel a slightly feedback as you move through each item.
